data.body: Implementation checkpoint for the comments/documentation-only leaf at commit `944f441a25d16a4dab60696682a6a3ae5e77b50e` (base `2eb1bd43950c5e058be475c7afd4625d7526fe1a`): exactly `.github/codeql/codeql-config.yml`, `.github/dependabot.yml`, and `.github/pull_request_template.md` changed, with 17 insertions and 40 deletions. Corrected the recorded YAML comment-only guard from escaped BRE-style grouping to Git's ERE grouping; the plan certificate remained current. Post-commit checks PASS: YAML comment-only diff guard; hidden-block comparator with all 22 visible template lines byte-identical; documentation index/link check; path-scoped `git diff --check`; commit-ticket trailer verification; and the pre-commit `make lint` gate. `/rebar-implement` behavioral RED-first tests are not applicable because configuration data and visible behavior-bearing documentation are byte-identical. Per operator direction, no full test suite was run. Independent reviewer `/root/review_goldfilled_comments` compared immutable blobs and posted the required 15-row TSV, with semantic-preservation and bloat-removal PASS for every scoped constraint and consumer.
